objective: Provide read-only cross-session context needed to bind contribution claims to the selected Loop Architecture contracts.
requestedOutcome: A sanitized context and claim packet covering execution-session observations, background-knowledge references, contribution boundaries, conflicts, unknowns, and reusable-artifact bindings.
successEvidence: The packet distinguishes user-provided coordination facts, directly observed artifact facts, bounded inference, and unknowns.
No raw prompt, transcript, private reasoning, secret, mutable handle, or peer-memory content enters durable output.
Every proposed reusable binding names an exact current owner and remains report-only.
AGENTS.md and reusable framework files remain unchanged by this role.
nonGoals: Editing AGENTS.md or any source file.
Writing the collaboration bundle or accepting another contribution.
Activating or controlling an Agent or session.
Changing canonical Loop Architecture contracts or components.
Accepting, publishing, or producing a final PDF.
boundedDiscoverySurface: Selected execution-session metadata and user-provided coordination facts.
Sanitized task-local run artifacts and settled contribution packets.
Reusable-artifact inventory metadata and admitted owner contracts.
validation: Loop Architecture owner and non-authority boundary review.
materialChangeSignals: Session, objective, source, owner, participant, artifact revision, effect, or sensitivity boundary changes.
stopConditions: Session identity or evidence provenance is ambiguous.
Private or restricted content would need to be disclosed.
The requested action exceeds read-only context integration.
